name: @zapwebp/core
description: The Zapwebp core conversion engine. Converts images with deterministic transparency preservation and zero-trust metadata stripping.

functions.name: convert
functions.signature: convert(input: Buffer | Uint8Array, options?: ConvertOptions): Promise<Buffer>
functions.description: Convert an image to a target format. Preserves transparency and strips privacy metadata by default.
functions.example:
import { convert } from '@zapwebp/core';
const webp = await convert(svgBytes, { to: 'webp', quality: 85 });

functions.name: convertImage
functions.signature: convertImage(input: Buffer | Uint8Array, options?: ConvertOptions): Promise<ConvertResult>
functions.description: Convert an image and return comprehensive metadata including dimensions, byte count, alpha preservation state, and format.

functions.name: convertSvgToWebp
functions.signature: convertSvgToWebp(svgStringOrBuffer: string | Buffer, options?: object): Promise<Buffer>
functions.description: Specialized high-performance vector-to-raster conversion via Rust resvg and libvips with crisp anti-aliasing.
functions.example:
import { convertSvgToWebp } from '@zapwebp/core';
const webp = await convertSvgToWebp('<svg ...></svg>', { width: 512 });

functions.name: inspectImage
functions.description: Inspect image container chunks, format signature, dimensions, and alpha channel presence without re-encoding.

functions.name: detectFormat
functions.description: Sniff magic bytes and header markers to identify image container format deterministically.
functions.example:
import { detectFormat } from '@zapwebp/core';
const fmt = detectFormat(bytes);

functions.name: verifyAlpha
functions.description: Examine decoded pixel buffer to verify if any pixel has an alpha value below 255.

functions.name: cleanMetadata
functions.description: Strip EXIF, XMP, IPTC, and C2PA metadata from an image while preserving container integrity.
functions.example:
import { cleanMetadata } from '@zapwebp/core';
const scrubbed = await cleanMetadata(rawBytes);

functions.name: listTools
functions.description: Return typed MCP-compliant tool schemas for runtime agent discovery without reading external docs.
functions.example:
import { listTools } from '@zapwebp/core';
const tools = listTools();

E_ALPHA_NOT_REPRESENTABLE.message: JPEG cannot store transparency. Pass a background color to flatten, or choose WebP, PNG, or AVIF.

E_UNSAFE_SVG.message: SVG contains active content (<script>, inline event handlers, or external entity).
E_UNSAFE_SVG.fix: Sanitize the SVG or pass allowUnsafe: true if in an isolated sandbox.

E_TOO_LARGE.message: Input image exceeds maximum allowed dimension or byte limit.
E_TOO_LARGE.fix: Downscale the image or adjust maxInputBytes in conversion policy.

E_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.message: Cannot decode or encode the requested container format.
E_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.fix: Use one of the supported formats: svg, png, jpeg, webp, avif, gif, tiff.
